in_sanskrit.name: जात
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is born or came into existence.

in_hindi.name: जात
in_hindi.long_meaning: जाना का प्रकार का शिखरी वाला व्यक्ति, जिसका जन्म हो गया है। (jānā kā prakār kā śikhari vālā vyakti, jiskā janma hō gaya hai.)

in_tamil.name: ஜாத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜாதிக்குப் போய்க்கும் (jādikkuppōykkum) - The one who goes to the place of Jat (Jathi).

in_telugu.name: జాట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: జాటిపోయిన (jāṭipōyin) - The one who has gone to the place of Jat (Jathi).

in_marathi.name: Jat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jatha', meaning 'group' or 'assembly'. In Hindu mythology, 'Jat' refers to a warrior or a member of a warrior class. The name is believed to bestow courage and strength.

in_bengali.name: Jat
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jat একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jatha', meaning 'group' or 'assembly'. In Hindu mythology, 'Jat' refers to a warrior or a member of a warrior class. The name is believed to bestow courage and strength.
